claim.summary: Neo-Assyrian legal records from Nineveh document the purchase and sale of enslaved persons, while specialist legal synthesis confirms that slaves could be owned and transferred as property within Neo-Assyrian household law. The atlas records a bounded positive slavery designation at Nineveh without converting a sale contract into a city-wide prevalence or labour-share estimate.
